notifications.title: The auditor ran before the day's data audit again
notifications.detail: Today's auditor run started by hand at 14:07 IST (08:37 UTC); the nightly auditor, research, improver and dashboard routines were all switched off at 14:06 IST. The Data audit workflow runs in the evening, so metrics/data-audit.json was from 10 Nov 16:29 UTC (16 h old) and the dashboard-vs-YouTube check was skipped. That audit had 0 errors and 0 warnings across 52 checked videos.
notifications.fix: 1. If you switched the nightly agents off on purpose, nothing to do. 2. Otherwise turn the four routines back on in claude.ai → Code → Routines; the auditor's slot should be after the evening data audit (23:00 IST).

notifications.title: The hourly watchdog runs only every 4-11 hours
notifications.detail: watchdog.yml is scheduled every hour, but GitHub ran it 11 times between 7 Nov 09:58 and 10 Nov 09:42 UTC (gaps of 4-11 hours). The hourly view snapshots behind the dashboard's 'realtime' chart and the variant system's 48-hour views therefore have gaps (the 48-hour count interpolates across them), and owner alerts can arrive hours late.
notifications.fix: Optional. 1. Accept it, or 2. trigger watchdog.yml from an outside scheduler (e.g. cron-job.org calling the workflow_dispatch API with a fine-grained token limited to Actions on this repo). Workflows are owner-only files.
